claims: Bianca Belair announced she is pregnant.
Bianca Belair made the pregnancy announcement on Night 1 of WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas on April 18, 2026.
Bianca Belair made the announcement alongside her husband Montez Ford.
Montez Ford is Bianca Belair's husband.
Montez Ford is a fellow WWE wrestler.
The announcement marked Bianca Belair's return to WWE after a one-year hiatus.
Bianca Belair revealed the pregnancy news at WrestleMania 42.
The baby will be Bianca Belair's first with Montez Ford.
Bianca Belair had not wrestled since the previous WrestleMania before making this announcement
